title: Practice 10: вз- (вс-): up — на-: onto, and a quantity covered

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Завтра они все ___ (взойти / всходить — to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend) по ступеням Машины Благодетеля.

exercises.context: взойти́** — **всходи́ть — to mount, to go up, to climb, to ascend; to rise (of a heavenly body).

exercises.context: налете́ть** — **налета́ть — to fly (upon, against), to come flying (to); (colloquial) to bump (into), to run (into), to hit, to collide (with).

exercises.q: ___ (натащить — to carry or drag) на себя форсу, что генерал (из полковников, по отставке получил), да и важничает.
exercises.why: The past tense is formed by dropping **-ть** from the infinitive and adding **-л** for the masculine, **-ла** for the feminine, **-ло** for the neuter, **-ли** for the plural: **работал**, **работала**, **работало**, **работали**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 36, 42.  ·  From Фёдор Достоевский, «Игрок».
exercises.context: The past tense is formed by dropping **-ть** from the infinitive and adding **-л** for the masculine, **-ла** for the feminine, **-ло** for the neuter, **-ли** for the plural: **работал**, **работала**, **работало**, **работали**.
